subject.title: feat: add Google Cloud Run sandbox provider

question: Should Crabbox adopt Google Cloud Run Sandbox, a public-preview remote execution surface, as a built-in provider with an ongoing gateway/security and compatibility support contract?
rationale: The patch is structurally aligned with the provider-adapter boundary and has real live proof, but whether this preview service belongs in the built-in provider set is a product and maintenance commitment that source review cannot decide.

options.title: Sponsor the built-in provider
options.body: Accept the preview-service support and remote-gateway contract, after removing the release-owned changelog entry.

options.title: Keep the integration out of core for now
options.body: Decline or defer built-in ownership until maintainers want to support the Cloud Run preview lifecycle and gateway contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the built-in provider
recommendation.body: Accept the preview-service support and remote-gateway contract, after removing the release-owned changelog entry.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history identifies this contributor as the only concrete person connected to the new provider implementation; maintainer ownership is otherwise not established in the available context.
